name: S8550
source: JCET (江蘇長電) S8550 データシート (版 B、2012-01)
description: PNP 汎用トランジスタ 25V 500mA (SOT-23, ピン1=B 2=E 3=C。S8050 の相補)。データシート (JCET) の代表特性から作った等価モデル (同じ型番でもメーカーで特性が違います)
hfe_note: 表の hFE は min・max だけ (50 mA で 120〜400、ランクで分かれる) なので、hFE−IC の図 (VCE = −1 V、25 °C) の値をそのまま使いました。実物はランクと個体で大きく違います。
vaf: 出力特性 (IC−VCE の図) の IB = −80・−120 µA の線の傾きから (2〜8 V で 54・51 V)
remarks: S8550 has no single maker; this is JCET's (Jiangsu Changjiang; the PDF names the company, from LCSC's copy). The same company's S8050 is used for that part

read with `cargo run -p datasheet --example ds -- trace ... abs` (the axes are labelled with negative numbers; the readings are magnitudes) on page 2; hFE and fT with `keepthin`. The VBEsat figure's axis (400 to 1200 mV) is logarithmic. Each graph has two curves, 25 C and 100 C
hfe_norm: the hFE-IC figure (VCE = -1 V), the lower curve (25 C), 2 to 300 mA
vce_sat, vbe_sat (mV): beta = 10; 25 C is the lower VCE(sat) curve (above 50 mA the two lie on each other) and the upper VBE(sat) one. vbe_on: the IC-VBE figure (VCE = -1 V), the right curve (25 C)
ft_typ: the fT-IC figure at 20 mA (VCE = -6 V), 202 MHz (the table gives min 150 MHz)
vaf: the IC-VCE figure, IB = -80 uA: 17.6 mA at 2 V to 19.5 mA at 8 V; -120 uA: 24.8 to 27.6 mA
